tasks.hint: You need to communicate this. Say you have a headache and need medicine.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask if the medicine makes you sleepy.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about side effects or drowsiness.

tasks.hint: A prescription is a formal authorization issued by a licensed medical practitioner. Present your prescription to the pharmacist.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'prescription'.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask where the thermometers are.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to buy a thermometer.

tasks.goal: Say you have a sore throat

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for lozenges or cough drops.

tasks.goal: Ask how often to take the medicine
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask about the dosage schedule.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how many times a day to take it.

tasks.hint: An allergy is an immune system hypersensitivity to a specific substance. Inform the pharmacist about your penicillin allergy.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'allergy'.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for bandages.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for band-aids or plasters.

tasks.hint: You need to communicate this. Say your eyes are dry.

tasks.hint: This is important context. Mention you have a high temperature.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for medicine for a cold.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for cold medicine.

tasks.hint: Symptoms are physical or mental indicators of a medical condition. Describe your symptoms to help the pharmacist recommend treatment.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'symptoms'.

tasks.goal: Ask if the medicine needs to be taken with food
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask if you should eat before taking it.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if it should be taken with food.

tasks.hint: You need to communicate this. Say the box is too big.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a smaller quantity.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a cheaper generic version.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for generic medicine.

tasks.hint: Efficacy refers to the capacity or power to produce a desired therapeutic effect. Inquire about the efficacy of the recommended ointment.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'efficacy'.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for sun protection.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for sunscreen.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for bug spray.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for insect repellent.

tasks.goal: Ask if you need to keep it in the fridge
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask about storage instructions.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if it needs refrigeration.

tasks.hint: You need to clarify the situation. Explain you lost the paper.
tasks.done_when: Learner said they lost their prescription.

tasks.goal: Ask to speak to the pharmacist
tasks.hint: You need something. Request the main pharmacist.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to speak to the pharmacist.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask to refill an old prescription.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a prescription refill.

tasks.hint: Adverse refers to harmful, unintended, or unfavorable medical reactions. Ask about potential adverse effects of the medication.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'adverse'.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for vitamin C.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for vitamins.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a rapid test.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a covid/antigen test.

tasks.hint: This is important context. Mention a stomachache.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned stomach pain.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for digestion medicine.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for stomach medicine/antacids.

tasks.goal: Ask what the expiration date is
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask when it expires.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about the expiration date.

tasks.goal: Ask if they accept your health insurance
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask if they take your insurance.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if their insurance is accepted.

tasks.hint: This is important context. Mention it is an emergency.
tasks.done_when: Learner said they need it right away.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a bag.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a paper bag.

tasks.goal: Ask if there is a generic alternative
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a generic version.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a generic version.

tasks.hint: This is important context. Mention a skin rash.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned a rash.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for skin cream/ointment.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for ointment.
tasks.scene_hint: Tubes of soothing hydrocortisone ointment and skin creams are arranged on the bottom shelf.

tasks.goal: Ask if the medicine is safe during pregnancy
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask if it's safe for pregnant women.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if it is safe during pregnancy.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask where baby formula is.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for baby formula.

tasks.goal: Ask how long it will take to prepare
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask about wait time.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how long to prepare the prescription.

tasks.goal: Say you will come back later

tasks.done_when: Learner said they will come back.

tasks.goal: Ask for the receipt for insurance
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a detailed receipt.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for an insurance receipt.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask what the correct dosage is.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about the recommended dosage.

tasks.goal: Ask for liquid medicine instead of pills
tasks.hint: You need to communicate this. Say you can't swallow pills.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for liquid medicine.

tasks.hint: You have a specific preference. Specify the patient is a child.
tasks.done_when: Learner said the medicine is for a child.

tasks.goal: Ask what age it is suitable for
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask the minimum age.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about age restrictions.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a cup to measure liquid.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a measuring cup or spoon.

tasks.goal: Ask how quickly the medicine takes effect
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask how fast it starts working.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how quickly the medicine works.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for hand gel.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for hand sanitizer.

tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for face masks.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a mask.

tasks.hint: It's time to go. End the conversation politely.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the pharmacist and left.

tasks.goal: Describe how you're feeling, then narrow it down
tasks.hint: Start general, then get specific when they ask.
tasks.done_when: Learner described a general complaint AND added a specific detail such as when it started or what makes it worse.

tasks.goal: Ask what happens if it doesn't agree with you
tasks.hint: Find out what to watch for and what to do about it.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about possible effects AND asked what action to take if they occur.

tasks.goal: Say you've already tried something and it didn't help
tasks.hint: Tell them what you tried and what happened, then ask what else there is.
tasks.done_when: Learner named a previous attempt AND described the outcome AND asked for an alternative.

tasks.goal: Check the instructions by saying them back
tasks.hint: Repeat what they told you in your own words to confirm you've got it.
tasks.done_when: Learner restated the instructions in their own words AND asked for confirmation.

tasks.goal: Explain a restriction and ask what fits
tasks.hint: There's something you can't take. Explain it and ask what would work instead.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated a constraint AND asked for a suitable alternative.
tasks.scene_hint: The pharmacist places two different pill bottles side-by-side on the counter tray for comparison.

tasks.goal: Turn down what they suggest and ask for something else
tasks.hint: Decline politely, say why, and ask what else they'd recommend.
tasks.done_when: Learner declined AND gave a reason AND asked for another option.

tasks.hint: You're already taking something else. Ask if the new medication is safe to combine with it, and say what you're currently taking.
tasks.done_when: Learner named what they're currently taking AND asked specifically about interaction risk.

tasks.hint: Your insurance doesn't seem to cover this. Explain the issue and ask what your options are.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained the coverage problem AND asked for alternative options.

tasks.goal: Push for a second opinion diplomatically
tasks.hint: You're not fully convinced by the first recommendation. Say so tactfully and ask for more explanation or an alternative.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed polite skepticism about the recommendation AND asked for further explanation or an alternative.

tasks.hint: What you need is out of stock. Explain why you need it urgently and ask for the closest substitute.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained the urgency AND asked for a specific substitute.

tasks.goal: Weigh long-term side effects out loud
tasks.hint: Ask about long-term risks of a treatment, then reason out loud about whether the benefit is worth it.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about long-term effects AND weighed the trade-off aloud AND asked for the pharmacist's opinion.

tasks.goal: Request documentation for a specific purpose
tasks.hint: You need proof of purchase or a note for insurance or work. Explain exactly why, and ask what they can provide.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained the specific reason documentation is needed AND asked what the pharmacist can provide.

tasks.goal: Raise a dosage concern for a special circumstance
tasks.hint: Explain a circumstance that might affect dosage (age, pregnancy, an existing condition) and ask them to confirm it's safe.
tasks.done_when: Learner disclosed the relevant circumstance AND asked for confirmation of safety or an adjusted dosage.

tasks.goal: Contest a mismatch between the label and what you were told
tasks.hint: Something on the label seems to contradict what you were told earlier. Point out the discrepancy and ask them to clarify.
tasks.done_when: Learner identified the specific discrepancy AND asked for clarification.
tasks.scene_hint: A printed prescription label on the amber vial shows instructions in black text.

tasks.goal: Negotiate switching to a cheaper alternative
tasks.hint: Ask if there's a generic or cheaper version, and ask how it compares in effectiveness.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about a cheaper alternative AND asked how it compares in effectiveness.

tasks.goal: Explain a past bad reaction and ask for reassurance
tasks.hint: You had a bad experience with something similar before. Explain what happened and ask if this one is different.
tasks.done_when: Learner described a past negative reaction AND asked whether the current option carries the same risk.

tasks.hint: Pharmacists often recommend specific allergy medicines to customers. Try asking the pharmacist about common allergy medicines.
tasks.done_when: Learner asks the pharmacist about allergy medicines
tasks.scene_hint: Shelves of antihistamines and nasal sprays line the counter display.

tasks.hint: Pharmacists can suggest various pain relief options based on the type of pain. Ask the pharmacist about pain relief treatments.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquires about pain relief options
tasks.scene_hint: A digital pharmacy monitor shows available over-the-counter pain relievers.

tasks.hint: Sometimes, customers are unsure about interactions between their current medications and any new ones. Ask the pharmacist about potential interactions.
tasks.done_when: Learner discusses medication interactions with the pharmacist
tasks.scene_hint: The pharmacist opens a thick medical reference binder on the glass counter.

tasks.goal: Request an explanation of side effects
tasks.hint: You have a new prescription and want to make sure you understand the possible side effects before taking the medication.
tasks.done_when: Learner asks the pharmacist about the potential side effects of the new prescription.
tasks.scene_hint: The pharmacist holds up an amber pill bottle with a yellow warning sticker.
